name: icontk
description: High performance Rust CLI and TypeScript API for icon set generation, format conversion, and AI icon synthesis

scripts.build: bun x @napi-rs/cli build --platform --release --output-dir dist && bun build index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node && bun build cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node && bun x tsc
scripts.build:debug: bun x @napi-rs/cli build --platform --output-dir dist && bun build index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node && bun build cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node && bun x tsc
